title: The Shift That Happens in My Studio: It’s Deeper Than You Think
summary: Another beautiful soul, Chloe, stood in my Cheltenham SEEN studio last month. She held a silk robe and took a deep breath... ->
body:
The quiet moment of ‘before’

I want to talk about the quiet moment of ‘before’…

Another beautiful soul, Chloe, stood in my Cheltenham SEEN studio last month. She held a silk robe and took a deep breath. “I’m doing this for him, but honestly, I’m terrified. I don’t see what you’re going to see as I am so so aqkward.”

And my heart smiled, because I knew what was coming…

Her bridal boudoir experience wasn’t just a photoshoot. It was a reclaiming. In those two hours, guided not with pressure but with quiet affirmation, she began to move differently. Yes, it felt awkward at first, and it’s totally normall to feel this way in the beginning (and honestly, everybody feels this way, but it only for the first 5-10 minutes!) She connected.. not with my camera, but with herself, the gorgeous woman about to become a wife. The fierce, gentle, powerful human in the mirror.

Seeing your own depth and power

This is what boudoir for brides is truly about. It’s the process of seeing your own depth and power reflected back at you. You delve deep. You feel the strength in your own gaze, the beauty in a genuine laugh, the aura of your own potential that you’ve been too busy to notice. Or perhaps because no one was able to capture you this way before.

Transformation & confidence building

Chloe’s session was a transformation. Not because I changed her, but because I gave her a new perspective, space and permission to see herself the way she hadnt experienced before. Without judgement. Only celebration.

When you view your boudoir photos as a bride, you’re not looking for flaws. You’re meeting the woman who had the courage to show up. That is the ultimate confidence building. It’s a gift that alters how you carry yourself, long after you leave the studio.

—

This is the core of your journey at SEEN.

It’s your story. You are SEEN my darling, most importantly by yourself.
And I would be honoured to help you discover that brilliance.

Let me tell you about a recent Melbourne bride, ms B.

Her wedding was set for November. Back in May, she sent me an enquiry. She was newly engaged, buzzing with ideas, and smart. She booked her pre-wedding boudoir session for August, giving us the perfect window before the final wedding chaos hit.

Because here’s the beautiful truth about bridal boudoir photography: it’s not a last-minute task, it’s a milestone.

When you book your boudoir session before your wedding with space to breathe, magic happens. You’re not rushed. We get our pick of prime dates at my Cheltenham studio. You have time to plan your outfits, feel excited, and truly embrace the experience as your own personal pre-wedding celebration, not another tick on a stressful list.

And most importantly, it ensures your stunning boudoir album for your husband is designed, crafted, and ready to become his most personal wedding day gift, without rush and on time before you walk down the aisle.

Your peace of mind is everything. Planning this unique wedding gift for him should be joyful, not frantic. That’s why I guide every Melbourne bride with a clear, stress-free timeline.

The best time to book

So, when is the best time to book? Ideally, 4-6 months before your wedding day.
This is your gentle nudge to secure your spot.

My Cheltenham boudoir studio is a safe space for this journey. And because I know how busy life gets, I offer simple payment plans to make this investment in your confidence effortless.

Ready to mark this beautiful experience on your calendar?

title: Melbourne Dog Photography Fundraiser for Australian Deaf Dog Rescue
summary: Melbourne Dog Photography Fundraiser for Australian Deaf Dog Rescue | Blog
body:
Rosie is a 1.8-year-old Mini Dachshund with a rare double dapple coat – a pattern that gives her those stunning, marbled markings, but is also linked to severe vision impairment.

Rosie was born blind, yet she was kept for breeding because of her colouring. When her puppies were also born blind, the breeders surrendered Rosie and her babies to a shelter and requested they all be euthanised.

Thankfully, Hear No Evil Deaf Dog Rescue stepped in, placed them in loving foster care, and began the search for new homes. I had the honour of donating a portrait session for Rosie and her human, Kat, and today, I’m sharing their story and photos as part of our Pet Glam portrait series celebrating Melbourne’s beloved dogs.

A PET GLAM PORTRAIT EXPERIENCE WITH PURPOSE

Calling all Melbourne dog lovers…

If you’ve ever loved a dog, you already know they aren’t “just pets.” They’re family, they’re joy, they’re the warm heartbeat at our feet. This series was created to celebrate that bond while also helping support animals that need a second chance.

Our Pet Glam Portrait Photography sessions give your dog or cat their own magazine-style photoshoot and yes, it’s as adorable and fun as it sounds! And a portion of every order goes directly to Hear No Evil Deaf Dog Rescue, helping dogs like Rosie receive the care, love, and forever homes they deserve.

Why Rosie’s Story Matters?

Rosie’s journey is a reminder that love sees differently. She may be blind, but she moves through the world with trust, softness, and joy. The way she leans into Kat’s touch… the way her tail wags at the sound of her name… the way she feels love. These portraits honour that bond.

Want to Get Involved?

If you have a dog who means the world to you, this is your chance to celebrate that bond in a way that lasts. Enjoy a Pet Glam portrait experience and take home the artwork you’ll treasure in your home, plus get a feature in our Pet Glam Magazine at the end of the series – a keepsake that highlights the love and personality of your dog. And with every session, you’re also supporting Hear No Evil Deaf Dog Rescue, helping dogs like Rosie find safety and new beginnings.

Celebrate your dog. Create artwork that lasts. Make an impact.
Book your Pet Glam session today!

title: Top Reasons Brides Love Boudoir Photography: A Pre-Wedding Must-Have
summary: A Pre-Wedding Must-Have: Boudoir Photoshoot. Learn more here ->
body:
What is Wedding or Bridal Boudoir?

Bridal boudoir photography is an intimate and empowering photoshoot that captures the bride in elegant and sensual poses, often in beautiful lingerie or tasteful attire. If you are sceptical about boudoir photography, it can draw a fine line between fashion portraits and what most of us want, in an elegant and glamorous way. This unique experience is the ultimate wedding gift for your soulmate, allowing you to present yourself in the most beautiful and personal way.

Why Invest in Bridal Boudoir Photos?

A Unique and Personal Gift

What comes to mind when you think of giving your fiance the perfect wedding gift? Perhaps something a bit more personal and special, and can we agree that there is nothing like giving a gift, that you have been a part of creating, while having an elevating and fun experience. And let’s be honest your partner will be crazy about it too!

Imagine the look on your groom’s face when he unwraps a stunning album filled with intimate, artfully captured images of you. Bridal boudoir photos are not just pictures; they are a heartfelt gift that speaks volumes about your love and commitment. 

Boost Your Confidence

Stepping in front of the camera in your finest lingerie, guided by a professional who knows how to highlight your best features, will leave you feeling empowered and beautiful. It’s a celebration of your body and your upcoming journey into marriage. 

Intimate boudoir photography is a fantastic confidence boost before your wedding. This intimate shoot helps you get comfortable in the spotlight, preparing you to shine with confidence as you walk down the aisle. During the session, you’ll learn how to pose your face and body, becoming more at ease not only in front of the camera but also in your own skin. It’s the perfect way to practice and relax before posing for all those wedding photos!

A Timeless Keepsake

our luscious boudoir photos wrapped in a bespoke fashion album, become a cherished keepsake. This elegant album not only makes a perfect gift for your groom but also serves as a beautiful reminder of this special time in your life.  Imagine you’ll be looking at your beautiful photos in 10, 20 years time, you might even show them to your daughter when she grows up – so precious! 

The Boudoir Experience

From the moment you step into our studio, you’ll be pampered and guided through the entire process. We ensure that you feel comfortable and confident, resulting in photographs that truly reflect your beauty and personality. Each shot is crafted to celebrate you, capturing your essence in a way that’s both stunning and intimate.

One of the Best Boudoir Photographers in Australia

Bridal Boudoir Style Photos

Remember, you are in charge of your boudoir experience. Choose the boudoir style photography that suits you best, and bring along your sexiest women’s lingerie and accessories to ensure you feel comfortable and confident. You can be totally nude or have your body covered – there is no right or wrong way doing your intimate photo shoot. On the day of the shoot, simply relax and let our makeup artist give you an exceptional styling experience. If you believe you don’t have a “boudoir body,” you’ll be surprised to learn how a boudoir shoot can boost confidence for all body types. Regardless of your background, height, or age, you can enjoy an empowering boudoir photography experience that highlights your best angles in a unique way. Embrace the moment, enjoy this incredibly exciting experience and feel undeniably sexy!

Give yourself and your gloved one the gift of soul-infused intimate portraits that will be cherished forever.

Here are links to some of our favourite wedding lingerie brands which will help you research what to wear and bridal boudoir photography ideas.

If you’re dreaming of capturing your stunning, confident self before your big day, now’s the perfect time to book your bridal boudoir shoot!

Let’s create beautiful memories that you’ll cherish forever. And when the big day arrives, I wish you all the magic and joy in the world. Here’s to celebrating your unique beauty and an unforgettable wedding experience.

Cheers to you and your exciting new chapter! 💕👰✨

title: Autumn Outdoor Pregnancy Photo Session
summary: Story - case: boudoir photo shoot of a pregnant woman | Our Portfolio
body:
You have just nine short months to cherish the little flutters of the first kicks, witness your tummy gently moving, and ponder sweet names for the precious being soon to join the world.

It is a privilege to photograph and craft art that celebrates the remarkable beauty of a feminine body that carries a little life growing within. This time is monumental and must be celebrated in all its splendour!

Creating life is an extraordinary gift: it’s wild, raw, joyful, beautiful, and powerful. Yet, it can also be challenging, filled with a whirlwind of emotions and physical sensations that can feel overwhelming.

As an all-female team (my team and I are mums!), we understand this! Your session is designed with your comfort in mind. We’ll take our time, pamper you, take breaks when needed and ensure you feel stunning in this magical moment. This experience provides an opportunity to connect with the wonder of creating life, to ground yourself in your body and to indulge in some much-needed self-care before your precious bundle of joy arrives.

We take extra care for our mum-to-be clients and provide a safe and supportive environment for your session recognizing that posing can bring extra challenges when you’re nurturing a baby within. A maternity boudoir offers a powerful means to document your journey of creating life, capturing all the remarkable changes along the way.

I’m thrilled to help you craft the artwork that beautifully encapsulates your memories of this special time. These treasures act as a gateway to the past, preserving your family’s legacy and nurturing a sense of belonging for your new baby and generations to come.

Much love, Marina.

body:
Beneath Her Skin Event: A Photo Chronicle

Exhibition Opening Night & Charity Event

The Photo Chronicle

Our series “Beneath Her Skin” culminated with an exhibition at our Melbourne studio in September 2023. I was honored to reveal the light and depth of each woman, celebrating our talents, beauty and creativity through my photography. Some participants shared their experiences, inspiring others to see the real women behind the project and demonstrating that this transformative experience is attainable for everyone, regardless of age, shape, or belief system.

Our guests left feeling profoundly empowered! We raised over $5,000 for Rotary Peninsula 2.0 in our charity auction and donated to women and children in Ukraine affected by the war.

My heart is full, and I’m deeply grateful to everyone who joined us, for the generous donations, and for the unparalleled atmosphere we created together!

Enjoy the photo story!

Much love,

Marina

title: The Grand Opening, Fundraiser and Exhibition
summary: Exhibition Opening Night & Charity Event in Cheltenham
body:
beneath her skin

Exhibition Opening Night & Charity Event in Cheltenham

CELEBRATE FEMINITY WHILE SUPPORTING A GREAT CAUSE

EVENT THAT INSPIRES AND creates CHANGE

We invite you to celebrate our first exhibition at SEEN, enjoy our soul-infused atmosphereand help us raise funds for a great cause supported by Rotary Club.

THE EXHIBITION

Beneath Her Skin is a celebration of a woman in today’s world

She’s had her own journey: a woman, a mother, a wife, a business mogul and a rebel at heart. Caught in daily life, she often feels disconnected from who she is and forgets how joyful and beautiful she can be. She’s torn between conforming to society’s standards and being who she knows she’s meant to be.

At the very core, this exhibition is about the JOY of returning to the truth of who you are as a woman and stepping into your most unapologetic self – the luxury AVAILABLE TO ALL women. No matter your age, size or insecurity in front of the camera, you can be confident, poised, and proud of who you are.

Through the series of emotive photographs portraying the spirit of a modern-day woman, that capture feminine beauty coupled with the power of resounding dignity, we want to invite YOU to embrace the joy of being free in your own skin, give yourself permission to step into your greatness and be seen, most importantly by yourself.

When you delve beneath your skin and embrace all of who you are, you are transforming into your own powerful Seen Queen who steps through life with newfound confidence.

Feel the power of a photograph that captures the embodied beauty of feminine energy in motion, and be empowered by the women that took part in this project that we created together with KunYin Studios.

Let this be your new source of inspiration, grace and impact. The age of invisible women is over. Welcome to SEEN.

MELBOURNE PHOTOGRAPHY EXHIBITION

THE POWERHOUSE

BEHIND THE INSPIRATION

The Artist

Through her empowering photography Marina helps women to discover their feminine power and reconnect with their wild, fun and spontaneous sides. Marina believes all these aspects are at the core of who the woman is and is something to be incredibly proud of. Her photographic voice speaks to women’s femininity, independence and sexuality through focusing on the raw, authentic, candid expression of yourself. Marina is excited and grateful to be your guide and to capture the natural pure essence of you through photography!

Special Guest and Sponsor

Joanne is the founder of KunYin ~ Feminine Energy in Motion, coach and mentor with over 15 years experience in working with women to live their best lives! A ThetaHealing practitioner and Instructor with experience in understanding the body and mind connection, she believes we can untangle and clear the patterns and beliefs in our body and mind that are holding us back to finally experience the extraordinary, purpose-driven living we desire.

THE CAUSE

A ticket fee and the funds raised at the charity auction will be donated to Rotary Peninsula 2.0 to support women and girls of Ukraine bearing severe impacts of war.

EVENT DETAILS

DATE: 1 September 2023, 6-8 pm

ADDRESS: 35 Belrose Avenue Cheltenham 3192

DRESS CODE: Smart casual.

THANK YOU FOR BEING A PART OF THIS SPECIAL EVENT!

title: A Brainwash for a Mum Like Me
summary: If you are like me, a mum who is always being the one behind the lens..
body:
If you are like me, a mum who is always being the one behind the lens, whether it’s your iPhone or maybe you are a professional photographer and your camera is awesome, but you still are behind the lens, this post is for you.

So we mums are photographers. We are taking photos of our kids, dogs, husbands and friends. We feel almost embarrassed when someone suggests to take a photo of us.. we say “No, thanks I’m good..” having in mind: “I need to fix this regrowth first”, or “I need to shred a few kilos, and then!” But months after months, we keep being behind the lens.

I can tell you right now: you are ENOUGH. You are who you are, own it! Not 15 years ago, not 20 kilos later. Your time is now. No more excuses, just get those photos of you done, you are awesome the way you are, they love you because you are what you are, so why are you making excuses?

Look at this photo of my daughter and myself, aren’t they amazing? They 100% are! And honestly speaking, I didn’t really have a decent photo of myself with my daughter till I started taking them a few years ago. Not a photo of my daughter, but a photo of her and I. Frankly, I don’t like my hands on these images, and I don’t like my wrinkles, and my belly that I’m hiding under this loose top.. You might not agree with me and say that I look awesome. And you are right, it all only lives in my mind. I feel the same way with my clients who tell me they don’t like their wrinkles, their nose, their arms, you name it.. The truth is – you are the only one who sees it, everyone else sees you as an awesome human being, a bright personality, an amazing woman. And I see your beauty through my lens.

“Oh my goodness is that me? I look bloody amazing!!” – this what I hear from my clients every single time when they look at their prints. I want you to see what I see through my lens, I have to show this to you. Connect with me on Instagram and let’s talk! ♥
